questions.q: What does Yahweh promise if his people return to him?
options: He will give them a king
questions.evidence: Therefore tell them: Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says Yahweh of Armies

questions.q: Whoever touches God's people touches what?
questions.evidence: for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye

questions.q: "Not by might, nor by power, but by" what, says Yahweh?
questions.evidence: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies

questions.q: What did Zechariah see flying, in Zechariah 5?
questions.evidence: Then again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a flying scroll

questions.q: On what does Zion's king come, lowly?
questions.evidence: lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey

questions.q: What was weighed out as the shepherd's wages?
questions.evidence: So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver

questions.q: In that day, Zechariah says, Yahweh will be King over what?
questions.evidence: Yahweh will be King over all the earth
